earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 a3q26earningsrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document MOODY’S CORPORATION REPORTS RESULTS FOR THIRD QUARTER 2026 NEW YORK, NY - October 21, 2026 - Moody's Corporation (NYSE: MCO) today announced results for the third quarter 2026 and reaffirmed guidance for full year 2026. “Moody’s delivered another quarter of strong profitability and earnings growth, with disciplined execution and healthy cash generation amidst an increasingly complex operating environment. It’s in markets like these that our customers truly value our independent insights and connected intelligence.” — Rob Fauber, President and Chief Executive Officer, Moody’s Corporation Third Quarter 2026 Highlights • MCO revenue of $2.0 billion increased 1% from the prior-year period and 3% on an organic constant currency 1 basis. • MCO’s operating margin was 44.8% and MCO’s Adjusted Operating Margin 1 was 52.6%. • Diluted EPS and Adjusted Diluted EPS 1 increased 18% and 6%, respectively, from the prior-year period. • Year-to-date, operating cash flow was $2,471 million, up 21%, and Free Cash Flow 1 was $2,200 million, up 22%. • Returned approximately $3.1 billion to shareholders year-to-date, including $2.6 billion of shares repurchased. • Reaffirmed guidance 2 for full-year 2026, including Diluted EPS range of $16.00 to $16.50 and Adjusted Diluted EPS 1 range of $16.50 to $17.00. CAPITAL RETURN • Moody’s returned approximately $3.1 billion to shareholders year-to-date, consisting of approximately $2.6 billion in share repurchases and $543 million in dividends. • On October 20, 2026, the Moody’s Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.03 per share of MCO Common Stock. The dividend will be payable on December 11, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 20, 2026. 4 OUTLOOK Moody’s outlook for full year 2026, as of October 21, 2026, reflects assumptions about numerous factors that could affect its business and is based on currently available information reviewed by management through, and as of, today’s date. reference.summary: Moody's Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated risk assessment firm in the United States, the rest of the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through two segments, Moody's Analytics (MA) and Moody's Investors Service (MIS). The MA segment develops a range of products and services that support the risk management activities of institutional participants in financial markets. This segment also offers credit research, credit models and analytics, economic data and models, and structured finance solutions; data sets on companies and securities; and cloud-based SaaS subscription solutions supporting banking, insurance, and know-your-customer workflows.
